says: In next/, the cloudflare folder's tests each declare the same one-line cast helper, and this diff adds a fifth copy plus two more casts of that kind, so 13 casts in readers.laws.test.ts sit under two shared SAFETY lines, where the plan meant Stub.make to hold the one cast.
proof: On origin/main d48ff74, `const fake = <A>(value: object): A => value as A;` is at ObjectService.test.ts:85, connection.test.ts:74 and error-cause.test.ts:59, and as `platform` at alarm.laws.test.ts:36. At e8e0b178c it is also at readers.laws.test.ts:81, with `const saved = <A>(value: unknown): A => value as A;` at :85 (13 call sites) and `const exec = (value: object): SqlStorage["exec"] => value as SqlStorage["exec"];` at ProjectAuditTest.ts:164. docs/plan/quests/mock-cloudflare-PLAN.md:205-206 says the casts go and Stub.make holds the one cast.
cost: Each copy takes a value past the compiler with one reason for many lines, which 0561 asks to be per line, and `saved` is the unknown-to-T cast that fabrika/no-type-assertions refuses when written inline. One typed fake beside Stub.make in the test package would hold it once.
